source_rules.rationale: Trusted loop-summary fact used to close SPEC: the finalized LOOP-SPEC proof uses a definition compiled with MPY-VERIFICATION as its main module, so this priority-40 rule is already present and is not first proved against a definition that excludes it.
source_rules.text:
rule
    <k>
      #loop(
        str(S:IntSeq),
        Name("character"),
        If(
          Compare(Name("character"), CmpOp("not in", Name("c"))),
          AugAssign(Name("result"), "+", Name("character"))
          Assign(
            Name("reversed_result"),
            BinOp("+", Name("character"), Name("reversed_result"))),
          .Stmts))
      => .K
      ...
    </k>
    <env> L:Int </env>
    <scopes>
      ...
      L |->
        ( scope(
            ( "s" |-> str(ORIG:IntSeq)
              "c" |-> str(C:IntSeq)
              "result" |-> str(A:IntSeq)
              "reversed_result" |-> str(RA:IntSeq)
              "character" |-> V:Val ),
            P:Parent)
        => scope(
            ( "s" |-> str(ORIG)
              "c" |-> str(C)
              "result" |-> str(keptAcc(S, C, A))
              "reversed_result" |-> str(reversedKeptAcc(S, C, RA))
              "character" |-> lastCharacter(S, V) ),
            P) )
      ...
    </scopes>
    [priority(40)]
